title: Reproducible Analysis Code for L-DEP-PD-1 Induction Therapy in EBV-Positive Lymphoma-Associated Hemophagocytic Lymphohistiocytosis

creators.name: Pi, Yubo
creators.affiliation: Department of Hematology, Beijing Friendship Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China

description:
Reproducible analysis code accompanying a prospective, multicentre, single-arm Phase 2 study of L-DEP-PD-1 induction therapy for Epstein–Barr virus (EBV)-positive lymphoma-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis (LA-HLH).

The repository contains scripts for data preparation and statistical analysis used to reproduce the quantitative results reported in the associated manuscript. Analyses include treatment response at weeks 2 and 4, EBV-DNA kinetics in plasma and PBMCs, paired laboratory parameter comparisons, adverse-event summaries, and Kaplan–Meier overall survival analysis.

The study included 24 adult patients with EBV-positive LA-HLH treated at three centres in China. The analysis code is designed to work with the accompanying de-identified patient-level dataset and provides a reproducible workflow for generating the reported study results.

Associated manuscript: Pi Y, Wang J, Zhou H, Pan X, Wang Z. Adding asparaginase and PD-1 blockade to the DEP regimen achieves rapid disease control and Epstein–Barr virus clearance in EBV-positive lymphoma-associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis.

ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT05775705.
